decisions.reason: The removed Youku integration is identified as an Android video integration; its removal does not alter the iOS modernization goal, maintainability requirement, or iOS runtime scope.

Removing Youku may incidentally affect packaged assets or code, but the source does not change the requirement to minimize Android application size or establish any specific size-optimization state change.
Removal of the Chinese Youku video integration does not change the requirement to localize the full Android application or its localization scope.
The Youku removal does not alter the policy to remove unused Android permissions or the identified READ_PHONE_STATE permission.
The source removes an Android Youku integration and does not change the iOS application-size optimization requirement.
The Youku integration decision does not modify full-app localization behavior or scope for iOS.
Removing the Youku integration does not eliminate or modify the independently required iOS Privacy Manifest.
The Youku removal has no necessary effect on the validity or renewal of iOS signing certificates.
Removing one Chinese video integration does not change the requirement for correct right-to-left layout behavior in Arabic, Hebrew, and Persian.
